name: Volume during conversation
description: While you talk to Atena it lowers music, Spotify, TV on Chromecasts and Home Assistant speakers by itself, and puts the previous volume back when the conversation ends (unless you changed it meanwhile).
capabilities: Music on Atena outputs (Chromecast, DLNA, PC)
Video and audio of the widgets on the display
Safe restore: never touches a volume changed by hand

settings.ATENA_DUCK_LEVEL: During the conversation the volume drops to
settings.ATENA_DUCK_HOME: Also lower TV and home speakers
